claims.claim: MakePlans launched an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that lets AI assistants like Claude or ChatGPT check availability, list services/events, look up customers, and create/cancel bookings.

excerpts.excerpt: Once connected, your assistant can work with your MakePlans account: Check availability and find open slots List your services and events Look up customers Create and cancel bookings
Once connected, your assistant can work with your MakePlans account: Check availability and find open slots List your services and events Look up customers Create and cancel bookings

claims.claim: The MCP integration is built on an open protocol rather than a proprietary plugin, so it can work with any MCP-capable assistant, not just Claude or ChatGPT.

excerpts.excerpt: We did not build a Claude plugin or a ChatGPT plugin. We built one integration based on an open protocol, and any assistant or agent that speaks MCP can use it

claims.claim: The MCP server authenticates using the business's own MakePlans API credentials, with the same access level as the private API, and is intended for the business rather than its end-customers.

excerpts.excerpt: The MCP server is for you , the business. It connects using your own MakePlans API credentials, with the same access as our private API. It is not something your end-customers connect their assistants to

claims.claim: MakePlans is a broader appointment booking and event registration system with an API and other integrations, of which the MCP server is an addition rather than a replacement.

excerpts.excerpt: a user-friendly system for appointment booking and event registration with a fully featured API and many integrations
this is an addition, not a replacement. The admin panel, the API, the integrations - everything works as before.
